themes.metaDescription: Browse the 21 UI design themes Saqina offers for your project, from modern SaaS and financial to minimal, organic and creative.

hero.title: Pick the look before you build
hero.description: Every project interview recommends a UI theme for your product. Browse all 21 here, see each one drawn with its own colours, type and shapes, and choose the one that fits your users.

note.title: Themes are design directions
note.body: A theme sets colour, type, shape and depth. It does not change what your product does. Concept themes are expressive, so we check contrast, motion and readability with you before launch.

cta.title: Let the interview recommend one
cta.description: Answer a few questions about your product and Saqina suggests a theme, with the reason. You can change it at any time.
